notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.1 116
notes.notes: [h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added AI difficulty levels : Easy, Medium, Hard[/p][list][*][p]Lower difficulty level means that the AI will be less accurate in what it does[/p][/*][*][p]Before the AI always played at the Hard level[/p][/*][*][p]Now Medium level will be default[/p][/*][*][p]Easy level won't use dashing[/p][/*][*][p]AI Difficulty toggle has been added to the options and the level selection screen[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]AI now better handles situations when the ball is at the level bounds[/p][/*][*][p]AI now will be more random on how it plays for variety[/p][/*][*][p]AI now guards teleporter exits better[/p][/*][/list][h2]Mechanics[/h2][list][*][p]Raised the default ball gravity up by 10% to improve the gameplay dynamic[/p][/*][*][p]Ball-jumps now makes the ball also inherit the character x velocity[/p][/*][*][p]Ball-jumps now make the character jump at 60% of total jump power instead of 100%[/p][/*][*][p]Ball-jumps now apply 40% more force to the ball[/p][/*][/list][h2]Characters[/h2][list][*][p]Rescaled all characters jumping, which is now higher, but they also fall faster[/p][/*][*][p]Raised all characters movement, which is now 10% more quick[/p][/*][*][p]Penguin [/p][list][*][p]Raised dash speed from 22 to 23[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Giraffe[/p][list][*][p]Lowered dash speed from 22 to 21[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Dragon[/p][list][*][p]Raised movement speed by 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Raised jump cooldown from 0.3 to 0.34s[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Lowered the UI bobbing amount by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization files[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update v1.1.0 112
notes.notes: [h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed wavy floor having no shadows.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed demo localization.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resolution refresh rate rendering sometimes being bad.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed localization in the level selection screen.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Level selection screen now remembers the last level selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Demo version now has a new character in a rotation system, meaning that a character has been added to the previous 3 demo characters, giving a total of 4 characters available in the demo. [/p][list][*][p]During this update this character is [b]Dragon[/b]. [/p][/*][*][p]The rotation character will change in future updates every once in a while.[/p][/*][*][p]Unlocked characters will still be unlocked when they get into rotation again.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Mechanics[/h2][list][*][p]Raised the default ball gravity up by 12.5% to improve the gameplay dynamic.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Added FishNet logo.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated localization files.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo is out!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone,

Get ready for some jiggly striking, as we've just released our demo on Steam. This is the first time when the game is publicly available to play.[/p][p]If you try out the demo and have any feedback, we would love to hear it (we have a [url="https://discord.gg/Wr6rwACVqh"]discord[/url] to make it easier). The feedback we collect from you will help us make the full release even better.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being with us[/p][p]- Voltrig[/p]
